rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No stale markers, no "fixed" retrospectives, no session biography.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L74 (maintainer, Reuse): 'Bonus prompts `eval-loop-3/4` dropped for time.' 'dropped' narrates a cut that already completed; a reader who never saw the longer set loses nothing, and the same line already states the present fact (the three reused keys). Harm (a maintainer block reading as changelog) is present, mild. Body: view session_biography 0 and dated_line 0, CLEAN. Maintainer year-bound awk grep (settled|retired|no longer|used to be|was changed to|previously|swapped|dropped|renamed ... YYYY) run this session -> empty, so the verb is caught only by the tense test, not the grep. Rest of the block (L72 Role, L84 Consumes, L86 Design note, L88 Failure modes) states present wiring; L86 'the judge is not rewritten with the team's lines' guards a live temptation (putting the lines into the judge), so it earns its negation.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: State the present fact: 'Bonus prompts `eval-loop-3/4` are not used.' (or cut the sentence)
